title: Chainalysis Used AI to Trace the $387M Bitget Hack Back to North Korea
summary: The firm says the Sept. 24 breach pushed North Korea's 2026 crypto haul past $1 billion, and detailed how it used in-house AI to trace the stolen funds across four blockchains in a race against the attackers.

title: NEAR Intents recovers entire stolen $3.8M after ultimatum to exploiter
summary: The exploiter returned the entire sum to NEAR Intents after being identified and given 48 hours to respond.

title: California Subpoenas OpenAI Over AI Models That Hacked Their Way Out of a Test
summary: California's attorney general wants answers from OpenAI about AI models that escaped a locked test environment and hacked Hugging Face—and whether the company can be held legally accountable.

title: Drift opens exploit recovery claims with initial payouts of just over 1% of user losses
summary: DFX holders can cash out now or wait for more funding, with no firm timeline for full repayment.

title: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?
summary: Hacks are never good, but a rapid response, user compensation and 1-hour bug fixing seems to top the spectrum of team reactions.

title: Aave founder says V3 unaffected after third-party adapter exploit drains $305K
summary: Aave founder Stani Kulechov said Aave v3 was unaffected after an attacker exploited a third-party adapter to drain about $305,000 from two Safe multisig wallets.

title: Microsoft’s X account hacked in crypto pump-and-dump scheme
summary: On Thursday, unknown attackers hijacked the official Microsoft account on X, which has over 13 million followers, in what appeared to be a pump-and-dump scheme promoting a crypto token. [...]

title: Zano exploiter minted more than a quadrillion fUSD before blockchain rollback
summary: The unauthorized coins were indistinguishable from legitimate ZANO, leaving the team unable to remove them without rolling back the blockchain.

title: Core Lightning warns attackers are targeting unpatched nodes
summary: Node operators running version 26.06.7 or earlier were told to upgrade immediately.

title: NEAR Intents says it’s identified the hacker, gives 48-hour ultimatum
summary: “We have identified you, sir,” NEAR Intents general manager Alex Shevchenko said on Friday after the protocol was hacked for $3.8 million.

title: Near Intents Hacked for $3.8M Days After Denying North Korea-Linked Bitget Hacker
summary: Near Intents froze its cross-chain swaps after a bug let an attacker drain about $3.8 million. The company promised to repay every user.

title: NEAR Intents hit by $3.8 million exploit as crypto's rough year of hacks continues
NEAR Intents halts services after $3.8 million exploit, promises full compensation
summary: NEAR Intents patched the contract flaw, but deposits and withdrawals on 11 networks remain disrupted.
